description: For a Monatsreporting run, lists every P&L position and whether it is commented, has an AI draft, or is still open. Covers P&L lines, summary metrics, cost centers and the total, each with a shareable deeplink and the published/draft comment text (body). Optional filters target_type and state. READ ONLY.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

state.description: Optional: only positions in this state. Counts refer to the filtered set; total_positions is unfiltered.

target_type.description: Optional: only positions of this type

name: list-comment-status
